entities.summary: "Kimi wa Boku Da"  is Atsuko Maeda's second solo single. It was released in three CD+DVD "act" editions. The title track was used a theme song for the movie LOVE Masao-kun ga Iku!, which starred Shingo Katori. Following the release of this single, Maeda held her first solo live on September 15 at Nakano Sun Plaza and on September 22 at Kobe Kokusai Kaikan.
